bills.title: Health Legislation Amendment (Data-matching and Other Matters) Bill 2019

name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2019-11-27.196.2) introduced by McMahon MP [Chris Bowen](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/mcmahon/chris_bowen) (Labor), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > > *"whilst not declining to give the bill a second reading, the House notes that the real risk to Medicare is the Government's cuts and neglect".*
